sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.3-8B-Instruct-128K is an extended-context variant of Meta's Llama 3.3 8B instruction-tuned model, maintained by shb777. This model extends the context window to 128K tokens (approximately 96,000 words) compared to the standard version, enabling it to process long documents, comprehensive codebases, and extended conversations in a single pass.
